minutes.headline: Selectmen agreed the stormwater task force must bring spending plans to the board before using the FY16 stormwater line.
minutes.summary: The board clarified that the stormwater task force, as an appointed body, will recommend expenditures of its FY16 DPW stormwater line to the Board of Selectmen rather than spend directly. Members also gave committee reports (school committee, finance committee, building committee), the town manager noted the FY17 budget presentation and a Chapter 70 resolution awaiting signatures, and the board appointed Nancy Forest to the senior property tax work-off committee.

votes.motion: Appoint Nancy Forest to the senior citizen property tax work-off committee

budget_items.topic: FY16 stormwater line in DPW budget
budget_items.what_was_said: A line in the FY16 DPW budget was set aside for stormwater projects with no specific projects identified. The board agreed the task force recommends and the board appropriates.
Possible uses: training, conferences, matching funds for grants, coalition fees, engineering, cleanup supplies, consultants.
If unspent, the DPW line could be used for snow and ice or special town meeting action.
Accounts payable warrant read, with deductions.
Twelve master teacher projects receive a stipend each per year; the mentor stipend is thought to be about eighteen hundred.
Replacement cell tower expected to generate revenue with annual escalator; needs school easement and Town Meeting approval.
Presented options of one, two or three artificial turf fields using cell tower money, school money and other group contributions.
A check was presented for the playground, with a little left to raise; a stone and gravel donation for the outdoor classroom was accepted.
Finance committee heard a presentation on Chapter 70 funding, foundation budget and net school spending.

decisions.decision: Stormwater task force will bring larger expenditure proposals (consultants, grant matches) to the Selectmen for approval; small items like workshops and memberships need not come back.
Board members who attended the finance committee meeting asked to sign the Chapter 70 resolution for forwarding to the legislative delegation.
Cable advisory meeting postponed to the third Monday in March.

what_happened.line: Selectmen agreed the stormwater task force will recommend spending from the FY16 stormwater line, and the board will appropriate it.
Larger proposals such as consultants and grant matches will come to the board for approval; small items like workshops and memberships need not.
The board voted to appoint Nancy Forest to the senior citizen property tax work-off committee.
Members who attended the finance committee meeting were asked to sign a Chapter 70 resolution for forwarding to the legislative delegation.
Committee reports covered artificial turf field funding options using cell tower lease money, and the cable advisory meeting was postponed to the third Monday in March.

why_it_matters: Money set aside in the DPW budget for stormwater will be spent only after the Select Board approves larger proposals in open meeting, which keeps those choices visible to residents.
Cell tower lease revenue and turf field options would need a school easement and Town Meeting approval, so residents may be asked to vote on them.

Select Board signatures on the Chapter 70 resolution and the FY17 budget presentation.
